q: Basic operation of a photocopier is the attraction of charged toner (ink) to the region on the _____ coated drum that is oppositely charged.
e: Basic operation of a photocopier is the attraction of charged toner (ink) to the region on the selenium coated drum that is oppositely charged. The physics in this sentence is built around selenium.

q: In electrostatic paint spraying, the droplets of paint emerge from the spray gun are _____ charged.
e: In electrostatic paint spraying, the droplets of paint emerge from the spray gun are positively charged. The physics in this sentence is built around positively.

q: In an electrostatic precipitator, the waste smoke, dust and fly ash are passed through a _____ charged mesh of wire in the chimney.
e: In an electrostatic precipitator, the waste smoke, dust and fly ash are passed through a negatively charged mesh of wire in the chimney. The physics in this sentence is built around negatively.

q: Television screen and computer monitors become charged with static electricity when they are _____.
e: Television screen and computer monitors become charged with static electricity when they are powered. Electrostatics is charge at rest. Like charges push apart.

q: A build-up of static charge is a potential danger when refuelling aircraft or vehicles because fuel running through the pipes can provide the _____ needed to create a static charge.
e: A build-up of static charge is a potential danger when refuelling aircraft or vehicles because fuel running through the pipes can provide the friction needed to create a static charge. The physics in this sentence is built around friction. Heat: energy that flows because of a temperature difference.
